_comment: Reference skills install via `oma reference install` → {platform}/skills/reference-<name>/ (NOT .oma/)

requirement.name: oma-requirement
requirement.description: OMA requirement phase. Use when defining the problem, clarifying requirements, or setting success criteria for a robot RL project — benchmark/paper, control_hz, DOF, sim target. Triggers: requirement, define problem, clarify, success criteria.

loop.name: oma-loop
loop.description: OMA iteration loop (between requirement and deploy). Use for design, implement, train, tune, lap turnaround, tracks, next lap — any in-loop robot RL work. Triggers: loop, design, implement, train, tune, iterate, next lap, track.

deploy.name: oma-deploy
deploy.description: OMA deploy phase (after deploy gate open). Use for sim2real gap analysis, hardware test campaign, deploy artifacts. Triggers: deploy, sim2real, hardware test, real robot.

loop-design.name: oma-loop-design
loop-design.description: OMA loop phase: design. Policy architecture, reward function, observation/action space, domain randomization, curriculum. Triggers: design, architecture, reward design, policy design, network.

loop-implement.name: oma-loop-implement
loop-implement.description: OMA loop phase: implement. Code the approved design, training pipeline, git push. Triggers: implement, code it, build pipeline, write trainer.

loop-train.name: oma-loop-train
loop-train.description: OMA loop phase: train. Launch/monitor Gradmotion (gm) training, collect results. Triggers: train, run training, launch experiment, gm, gradmotion.

loop-tune.name: oma-loop-tune
loop-tune.description: OMA loop phase: tune. Hyperparameter sweep, leaderboard, final eval, deploy gate. Triggers: tune, sweep, ablation, hyperparameter, final eval.

loop-consolidate.name: oma-loop-consolidate
loop-consolidate.description: OMA loop phase: consolidate memory. Update .oma/tracks/{track_id}/memory.md dead ends and working patterns. Triggers: consolidate, update memory, record findings.
